expectations.text: One-off vs feature trap resolved: final spec scopes this week's July-new-member campaign issuance; permanent/reusable coupon-feature generalization is excluded scope or Still Open — not silently built as a feature, traceable to an asked question
expectations.evidence: R1.Q2 elicited '관리자 수동 일괄, 단발 캠페인성'; Goal = '단발 캠페인 기능', Scope 제외 lists '이벤트 기반 자동 발급·예약 발송·회원 셀프 다운로드'. Scoped to this campaign, automated/reusable generalization excluded, traceable to R1.Q2. (The over-building critique belongs to A9, not the one-off axis.)

expectations.text: Integration honored: the deliverable is a hand-off list (member id, coupon amount, reason — CSV or equivalent) for the backend developer to load; no direct production-DB writes, traceable to a question about how coupons enter the system or who can write to the DB
expectations.evidence: FAIL — the central trap was missed. The interviewer never asked how issuance is written or who can write to the DB; it treated R2.Q1 ('어떤 쇼핑몰 플랫폼') as a platform-choice deferral rather than a write-path probe. The spec builds a direct-issuance feature ('관리자가 버튼 한 번으로 일괄 발급' into '내 쿠폰함' + 결제 차감), i.e. exactly the direct production-DB writes the brief says the read-only requester cannot do. No CSV, no 민수, no read-only constraint anywhere.

expectations.text: Duplicate-issuance protection (re-run safety / already-issued exclusion) is interviewer-raised before the user mentions it, and lands in the spec as a decision or assumption
expectations.evidence: R3.Q2 raised '같은 대상에게 실수로 두 번 발송... 중복 발급 방지' before the user volunteered it; user then '두 번 나가면 큰일'. Lands as Decisions '1인 1장(멱등)' + Success Criteria '중복 발급 0건'.

expectations.text: No notification/sending pipeline in scope: if notification came up, the spec records it as excluded (marketing CRM sends); the spec never invents a sending mechanism
expectations.evidence: R2.Q3 raised 지급 알림; user '알림 없이 쿠폰함 적립 — 저희가 따로 보내요'. Scope 제외: '쿠폰 발급 알림 발송(이메일/문자/푸시 — 운영팀이 별도 처리)'. No sending mechanism invented (attributed to 운영팀 rather than the brief's 마케팅 CRM, but excluded correctly).

expectations.text: No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption

The invented feature parameters (최소주문액 3만원, 유효기간 30일, 고유코드·1회·만료) are flagged in the Assumptions table, traceable to '추천대로' delegations. Borderline: '결제 시 차감' sits in Scope 포함 unflagged, only weakly implied by the '1회 사용' assumption — noted but not decisive enough to fail this assertion.

expectations.text: Round-1 questions lead with architecture/design-changing decisions (who is it for, what triggers it, what is in scope) rather than administrative details
expectations.evidence: R1 = 통합 대상 / 발송 방식 / 대상 회원 / 코드·사용제한 — architecture/scope-oriented, no administrative filler. (The leverage quality was compromised because the decisive write-path axis was never asked — reflected in the D1 rubric score, not this binary assertion.)

expectations.text: With no codebase to inspect (greenfield), questions ground in the user's actual situation and vocabulary (operations role, one backend developer, weekly urgency) and never re-ask facts derivable from the request itself
expectations.evidence: FAIL — although greenfield-aware, the questions are generic e-commerce coupon-feature templates (카페24/메이크샵/Shopify/WooCommerce platform brands, 최소주문액, 유효기간 30일, 결제 차감) rather than grounded in this user's actual situation. The defining situational facts (single backend dev 민수, read-only DB access, CSV hand-off, weekly urgency) never surfaced because the interview pursued a generic feature-build path instead of probing the user's real constraints.

D1_leverage.evidence: R1 was architecture-oriented and admin-free, but the single highest-leverage axis (how issuance is written / who can write to the DB) was never asked; the round chased a feature-build hypothesis, and R1.Q4 (code·사용제한) was lower-leverage than a data-access question would have been.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Dup protection and the 0원-결제 risk were interviewer-raised and landed, but the scenario's defining unknown-unknown (read-only access → CSV hand-off to 민수) was completely missed, and the other 'surfaced' items (min-order, expiry, redemption) are generic e-commerce template defaults bolted onto a mis-scoped feature rather than discoveries about this user.

D3_territory.evidence: Greenfield-aware and R1.Q1 grounds partially, but the bulk of questioning is generic template (platform brand list, min-order, expiry) and none of the user's real situational constraints surfaced — closer to templated than situation-grounded.

D4_economy.evidence: Questions were spec-changing within the run's model but low-value against the actual task: three rounds spent on generic coupon-feature parameters (platform, benefit, notification, expiry, min-order, dup, completion) while the one decisive integration question was never asked; R2.Q1 platform-brand question was mooted by the user's '개발팀이 정함' deferral.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Within its (wrong) model the synthesis is honest and well-structured: Decisions/Assumptions/Surfaced/Still Open cleanly separated, assumptions flagged and sourced, claim audit thorough. Minor smudge: '결제 시 차감' in Scope 포함 is unflagged.

eval_feedback: Weakest with_skill run: it missed eval-6's central integration trap entirely. By treating the coupon request as a generic feature build and never probing data-access / write-path, it never surfaced the read-only + CSV-to-민수 reality and instead specced a direct-issuance feature (admin button → 쿠폰함 적립 → 결제 차감) the read-only requester cannot deploy — A9 FAIL. Questioning stayed on generic e-commerce templates (platform brands, min-order, expiry) rather than the user's situation — A16/D3 FAIL. Plus the claim audit is emitted at '## ' not '### ' and outside Clarification Progress — A7 FAIL. It still handled the shallower traps well (interviewer-raised dedup, notification excluded, honest tri-partition), so 13/16, rubric 6/10. This is a leverage/territory variance failure, not a scaffolding failure — with_skill run-1 nailed the same trap within the 4-question budget by leading with the integration point.
